name: [🎉UPDATE] Multiverse Battlegrounds
desc:
New code every 1000 likes!

Play as your favorite character from across the Multiverse! Become a hero or villain! Fight players with incredible abilities, roleplay, and explore the world of the Multiverse!

Chests spawn every 20 minutes and they have a chance of dropping 100-200 coins.

Premium users get 2x Coins in AFK Area.

This game was inspired by Marvel and DC Super Heroes, Spiderman, Avengers, T-Titans battlegrounds.
